text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days of accumulating training
toward the Osaka Hai continued.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My time... won't go down... at all...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why why why whyyy~?!
I've been training so hard, too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the time wasn't bad enough to cause an uproar,
it was true that progress had plateaued.
choice_data_list: Maybe I should try changing the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah! In that case, I've got an idea!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Training that can fire me up
from deep within!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*, calling me out so suddenly, and for this?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A mock race... with us...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the results from my training
haven't been so great lately.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I figured if Taishin and Hayahide ran with me,
I could run as well as I do in a real race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Besides, back when my progress stalled,
you ran alongside me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Around the time of the Hopeful Stakes, huh.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it! It was thanks to that mock race back then
that I was able to beat my personal record!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So I was wondering if things might turn out like that this time too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. A mock race will be
good training for us as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin, what will you do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...If Hayahide is running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not like I haven't noticed
how much you've grown since the 'Kikuka Sho'."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Then I can't afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiight, let's do thissss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the cloudy sky, the gates clanged open with a resonant sound.
The three dashed out all at once.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwoooooooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? A mock race?
Wait, that's Ticket-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"It's a mock race with BNW!
It really is great when the three of them are together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Since it was a BNW mock race,
students from the academy had come to watch."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True to expectations, the race was fiercely contested.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —...Or so it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(H-Huh!? Why why why!?
I'm falling further and further behind...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight, leaving Winning Ticket behind,
the other two unleash an eye-opening burst of acceleration—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaahーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I'd loooose!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result was Biwa Hayahide in the lead,
with Narita Taishin a neck behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From there, Winning Ticket ended up falling behind by about five or six lengths...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They pulled away from me in an instant~!
And my time didn't improve at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's shoulders slump in disappointment at the result. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-senpai!! That was so close!!
Still, that was a wonderful race!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy I got to see
BNW's heated race in person~!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
When did such a crowd gather!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...My results were pretty mediocre,
but everyone's still happy for me."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When rivals run against each other,
it really makes for a heated race...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, I'll work even harder next time
and make the race even hotter!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide, Taishin, let's run one more!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin's already gone.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Why, why!?
Where did it go!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's the uphill course.
She did say she was going to get some running in.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aww, no way~! And here I wanted to run together more!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It seems losing that final battle against me
hit them pretty hard.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I really think a practice race would be way better than training alone, though.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, that race earlier
was really great."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...A good race?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That dead heat between Taishin and Hayahide at the end
was absolutely electric!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Everyone's saying it was a heated race too~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think so too?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Even though you suffered defeat...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? I mean, sure, I didn't do so great,
but... it'll be different next time!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna work even harder so I can run alongside you
and show everyone an incredible race just like at the Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see. The greatest race, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Ticket, but I should get going too.
See you later.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Even Hayahide...? What came over everyone all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh...! In the end, I couldn't beat my time right down to the very finish!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If only we could've kept the mock race going a little longer, my time might've improved...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally!
Let's just say days like this happen!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Taishin and Hayahide were
seriously amazing today, weren't they~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They felt like real, fierce rivals, you know?
It's a huge bummer I couldn't be out there with them.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm your rival too! I'll do my best so we can put on an amazing race together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Winning Ticket stayed positive until the very end,
there was a slight sense of unease,
as if something was just a little off.
